description: This is an abstract PHP class that defines a base processor for registration events within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling registration event data, saving events, publishing events, and gathering system and organization information. Being an abstract class, it outlines the structure for subclasses that will specify particular registration event types and data.

classes.name: AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class that provides foundational methods for processing registration events, including data collection, event saving, and publishing. It serves as a base for specific event processors.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventQueueDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of RegistrationEventQueueDao, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getRegistrationAPIClientService
methods.description: Returns an instance of RegistrationAPIClientService, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getOrganizationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of OrganizationService, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Processes and saves a registration event if they are to be saved.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventGeneralData
methods.description: Gathers general data about the registration event, including admin info, system details, organization info, and environment.

methods.name: processRegistrationEventToSave
methods.description: Creates a RegistrationEventQueue object with event metadata and data to be stored.

methods.name: publishRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Publishes unpublished registration events via the API client if in production mode.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventPublishDataPrepared
methods.description: Prepares event data payload for publishing, adding type and event time.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the event type ID.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide specific event data.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to determine if the event should be saved.
